create_readingorder_model: create a ReadingOrderModel instance with ReadingOrderOptions to predict document reading order
run_reading_order: run the ReadingOrderModel on a ConversionResult to produce a DoclingDocument with correct reading order
build_readingorder_elements: build ReadingOrderPageElement objects from assembled ConversionResult elements with bounding boxes and labels
convert_to_docling_doc: convert sorted reading order elements with caption, footnote, and merge mappings into a DoclingDocument
merge_text_elements: merge adjacent text elements with matching labels into a single item with combined provenance
